item.title: No Extension For Contract Pharmacists, Applications Open End 2027: MOH
item.description:
Source: CodeBlue (Malaysia Health)
MOH says there are no contract extensions for over 40 pharmacists who lost their jobs last Saturday because they reached their max 5-year contract duration. They may reapply in more than one and a half year's time when permanent recruitment opens end 2027. item.title: WHO calls for action: “Together for health. Stand with science.” to mark World Health Day
item.description:
Source: WHO News (Global Health)
The World Health Organization (WHO) today calls on people everywhere to renew their commitment to working together and supporting science as the twin engines driving better health, under the World Health Day 2026 theme: “Together for health. Stand with science.” The campaign marks the anniversary of WHO’s founding on 7 April 1948, launching a year-long public health campaign.
